authority.live_resource_validation: the registered mac-14 resource must pass the exact remote preflight before mutation
authority.credentials_policy: references only; secrets are never stored in Git

database_administration_binding.purpose: bind fresh-only P0-E databases to lease-bound remote administration
database_administration_binding.owner: Peanut Admin P0-E project-resource lease owner
database_administration_binding.data_source: explicit private Project resource registry plus the live registered mac-14 resource
database_administration_binding.freshness_requirement: after claim and before mutation, both project registries and the live resource must agree on the resource, image, endpoint and version
database_administration_binding.cleanup_responsibility: the active P0-E lease owner drops only its exact run_id databases

browser_host_binding.purpose: separate PlatformOperator and shared Tenant Admin hosts during the local production-mode P0-E browser gate
browser_host_binding.owner: Peanut Admin P0-E project-resource lease owner
browser_host_binding.service_type: RFC 6761 localhost aliases served by the lease-bound Compose Nginx listener
browser_host_binding.data_source: lease-bound Compose environment and the browser's native .localhost resolution
browser_host_binding.freshness_requirement: after the Compose health check, each exact host must resolve to loopback and preserve its Host header through Nginx
browser_host_binding.health_check: GET /healthz at both registered hosts and port while the P0-E lease is active
browser_host_binding.cleanup_responsibility: the P0-E runner removes the exact Compose listener with its lease-bound stack

tooling.owner: Peanut Admin project; consumes the registered mac-14 MySQL allocation
tooling.service_type: MySQL CLI inside the allocated database container over SSH docker exec
tooling.credential_ref: the registered container's MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD environment; never transferred to the workstation
tooling.data_source: live Peanut Admin resource peanut-admin-mysql84-development on mac-14
tooling.freshness_requirement: after claim and before any database mutation, verify the exact container image, running/healthy state and MySQL CLI version
tooling.fallback: none; host mysql commands are forbidden
tooling.cleanup_responsibility: not applicable; the tooling runs inside the existing persistent allocation

tooling.purpose: give Docker Desktop containers a lease-owned route to the registered remote P0-E MySQL endpoint
tooling.service_type: loopback-bound SSH local TCP forwarding consumed through host.docker.internal
tooling.credential_ref: operator-local SSH configuration for alias mac-14
tooling.freshness_requirement: port 20189 is unbound before allocation; SSH forwarding becomes reachable before Compose starts
tooling.health_check: host TCP probe followed by the production PHP container database readiness gate
tooling.lifecycle: single fixed-candidate P0-E run; recreated on resume
tooling.cleanup_responsibility: the P0-E runner terminates only its child SSH process and proves the listener is absent

tooling.purpose: fixed local Playwright CLI wrapper for the P0-E Chromium browser groups
tooling.freshness_requirement: the fixed wrapper must be executable and its --version output must contain playwright-cli and 0.1.18 before any P0-E resource claim
tooling.cleanup_responsibility: the candidate worktree owner may remove the ignored .local wrapper and npm cache after evidence capture
